title: CMake builds
description: Configure and build with cmake, from CMake.app or installed with Homebrew.
notes: The compiler and make come with the Make pack, and a cmake installed with Homebrew with the Homebrew pack: both come with this one.
With cmake -G Xcode, tick the Xcode pack as well: xcodebuild keeps caches and build folders outside the project.
Not covered: a cmake installed another way (MacPorts, pip, a folder of your own). Record a pack for it.
A project whose build reads folders outside the project, such as a dependency checked out beside it, needs those added.

recorded.by: sandbox-discover, with CMake.app 4.3.3 and Homebrew's cmake 4.4.3, then a build under each pack's folders alone (Makefiles; the Xcode generator with the Xcode pack)
